item.title: New architecture and design competitions: ASLA Student Awards, Erich Mendelsohn Award, National Assembly Sejong Complex, and Sanya Dadonghai Urban Renewal
item.description: Bustler's curated picks of new architecture and design competitions this week feature four calls seeking outstanding proposals for the National Assembly Sejong Complex and its surrounding spaces in South Korea, visionary renewal plans that would transform a seaside resort into a mixed-use urban coastal destination in Sanya, China, excellent student-crafted landscape architecture projects, and the best buildings made of brick.For the complete directory of newly listed competitions, click here.

item.title: Pine Flat by Faulkner Architects
item.description: Remotely accessed via a winding former stagecoach road north-east of Healdsburg, California, the 2019 Kincade Fire destroyed the original off-grid house. The pioneering resourcefulness of the clients allowed them to embrace an alternative, landscape-driven lifestyle, that follows the spirit of the nearby original historic Pine Flat community – a boomtown that flourished in the Mayacamas Mountains during the quicksilver and mercury rush in the 1870s. item.title: office VLASNE MISTO by KUDIN architects
item.description: Vlasne Misto is an autonomous city for 47,000 residents in the suburbs of Kyiv. The construction began in 2021. KUDIN architects is a co-author of this ambitious project. The first completed building is the Information Center — a space where visitors can learn more about the concept and future appearance of the city. item.title: Amid ICE chaos in Minneapolis, we spoke with local architects and organizations
item.description: Minneapolis’ architecture community has spoken out following violent scenes in the city in recent weeks. Two U.S. citizens, named Renée Nicole Good and Alex Pretti, have been killed by federal immigration officers during a surge in ICE activity across the city; actions which have triggered mass protests and strikes across the United States.
